title: Build a Jinja Filter Plugin
objective: Understand the contract and safe use of custom filters.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: A filter plugin exposes Python functions through a FilterModule mapping so Jinja expressions can transform data. Functions should be deterministic, narrow, documented, and tested.
Prefer built-in filters when they express the intent. Custom plugins create a maintenance and distribution obligation, and should produce clear errors for invalid input.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Understand the contract and safe use of custom filters.
